items.topic: What domain does this idea target?
items.context: The description 'A new test idea' and tags 'new, test' are ambiguous. We need to identify the problem domain before any meaningful planning can begin. Does this relate to testing infrastructure, a new product concept, or something else entirely?

options.label: Testing infrastructure/framework
options.rationale: Build or improve test tooling for Vrooli scenarios (e.g., test harness, test generators, test reporting)

options.label: New product/scenario concept
options.rationale: A new scenario delivering user-facing value, with 'test' referring to its experimental nature

options.label: QA/validation tooling
options.rationale: Automated validation of scenario outputs, integration test suites, or CI/CD test pipelines

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Provide your own description of the domain

items.context: Understanding the audience shapes the entire architecture. Internal tooling for developers has very different requirements than a user-facing product.

options.label: Vrooli developers/agents
options.rationale: Internal tooling — focus on CLI, APIs, and automation-friendly interfaces

options.label: External end users
options.rationale: User-facing product — needs UI, onboarding, and polish

options.label: Both internal and external
options.rationale: Dual-purpose — developer API with a user-friendly UI layer on top

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Provide your own target audience

items.context: A clear problem statement is essential for scoping. What pain point or opportunity motivates this idea?

options.label: Reduces manual effort in an existing workflow
options.rationale: Automation play — measure ROI by time saved

options.label: Enables a capability that doesn't exist yet
options.rationale: Greenfield capability — measure by what becomes possible

options.label: Improves quality/reliability of existing systems
options.rationale: Quality play — measure by error reduction or confidence increase

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Describe the problem in your own words

items.topic: New scenario or enhancement to existing?
items.context: This determines whether we're creating a new scenario from scratch or extending an existing one. Affects scope, dependencies, and architecture decisions.

options.label: New standalone scenario
options.rationale: Clean slate — full control over architecture, but more work to set up

options.label: Enhancement to an existing scenario
options.rationale: Builds on existing infrastructure — faster to deliver but constrained by current design

options.label: Cross-scenario capability
options.rationale: Shared infrastructure used by multiple scenarios — highest impact but requires careful API design

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Provide your own approach

items.topic: What file paths are expected to change?
items.context: The acceptance_allow field is currently empty. Defining expected change boundaries enables sandbox enforcement and post-execution review. This can be refined later once the domain is clearer.

options.label: Broad scenario-level globs (e.g., scenarios/new-test-idea/**)
options.rationale: Appropriate if creating a new standalone scenario

options.label: Targeted subdirectory/file paths
options.rationale: Appropriate if modifying specific parts of an existing scenario

options.label: Defer until domain is clarified
options.rationale: Cannot set meaningful boundaries until we know what we're building

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Specify custom glob patterns

items.notes: Pre-selected: deferring is the right call given the current lack of clarity on domain and scope

items.topic: What resources would this idea likely need?
items.context: Vrooli provides shared local resources (postgres, redis, qdrant, ollama, etc.). Early resource identification helps shape the architecture.

options.label: Database only (postgres)
options.rationale: Simple CRUD with persistent storage

options.label: Database + caching (postgres + redis)
options.rationale: Standard web app pattern with performance optimization

options.label: AI-powered (ollama + qdrant + postgres)
options.rationale: AI/ML features requiring inference and vector search

options.label: Minimal/none
options.rationale: Stateless utility or CLI tool with no persistence needs

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Specify your resource requirements

items.text: The current spec is extremely minimal ('A new test idea' with tags 'new, test'). All plan sections are TBD pending answers to the decisions in this round. A second workshop round will be needed to flesh out architecture, testing, and implementation details once the domain and scope are clarified.
